_comment: Ages in order. An age is reached once every innovation in 'requires' is discovered (and all earlier ages are reached). Innovations in data/innovations/<age>.json can only be researched once their age is reached, so each age's 'requires' must come from earlier ages. 'government_on_arrival': when the society enters the age, its government changes by itself into the first of these (data/governments keys) whose own 'requires' are all researched, else the last one; nobody votes or decides. Office holders carry over as the new government's 'carry_over' says; new offices start empty. So the research done before the age arrives picks the government (Tribal Council: a Village Council). Within an age, changing to another form of that age is a reform.

ages.name: Tribal Age
ages.description: Small kin groups that move with the seasons. Leadership is by influence and agreement.

ages.name: Stone Age
ages.description: Settled villages, farming, and chiefs with lasting authority.

ages.name: Metal Age
ages.description: Metal tools, writing, trade networks, and the first states.
